description:
Decode protobuf wire format without a schema: field numbers, wire types and values, nested messages detected by trial decode. Length-delimited fields are genuinely ambiguous without the .proto (string vs bytes vs message vs packed), so every reading that fits is shown — varints as both unsigned and zigzag — rather than one guess.

Returns: One line per field: number, wire type, value(s); nested decodes indented, with the alternative text reading noted when both fit.
Example input: {"data":"089601120774657374696e67"}
On error, includes hint: Field 1 varint 150 then field 2 string "testing" — the examples from the protobuf encoding guide.

data.description: The message bytes, hex or base64.

name: proto_decode
title: Decode protobuf wire format
